run_print_config: run the print_config tool to load and display an mmcv config file to stdout
run_print_config_with_options: run print_config with --options flags to override specific config values before printing
parse_args_parse_config_path: parse command line arguments to extract a config file path and optional dict overrides
main_load_and_print_config: load an mmcv config from file, merge CLI options, and print the formatted config text
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that uses argparse with DictAction for config file and options
